newsitem.title: UK: Algeria raises Oct crude price by nine cents - trade.
newsitem.headline: Algeria raises Oct crude price by nine cents - trade.

text.p: Algerian state oil company Sonatrach is very close to setting the value of its Saharan Blend crude lifting in October at Dated Brent +70 cents, nine cents above September's price, contract holders said on Wednesday.
"Algeria is 99 percent settled at +70 cents," said one.
"With the new spec of gas oil in Europe, I think Saharan Blend is a peculiar grade and we expect big interest this winter. I think it's not far from the real value of the crude," he added.
